Title: ALAS2023-2026-412: openssh signal handler race condition (RegreSSHion)
Description: A signal handler race condition was found in OpenSSH's server (sshd) on Amazon Linux 2023 allowing remote unauthenticated code execution.

Title: CVE-2024-45337 - golang.org/x/crypto/ssh ServerConfig PublicKeyCallback Authorization Bypass
Description: Applications and libraries that use ServerConfig.PublicKeyCallback in golang.org/x/crypto/ssh may be vulnerable to an authorization bypass when multiple keys are presented.
Remediation: Update golang.org/x/crypto to v0.31.0 or later and rebuild container image.

Title: CVE-2023-44487 - HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Attack (nginx)
Description: The HTTP/2 protocol allows a denial of service (server resource consumption) because request cancellation can reset many streams quickly.
Remediation: dnf update nginx to 1.22.1-4.el9 or later.

Title: CVE-2024-2511 - OpenSSL Unbounded Memory Growth in TLSv1.3 Session Cache
Description: Some non-default TLS server configurations in OpenSSL can cause unbounded memory growth when processing TLSv1.3 sessions.
Remediation: dnf update openssl-libs to 3.0.7-27.el9 or later.

Title: CVE-2025-21502 - Minor CPython urllib URL parsing edge case
Description: Improper validation of bracketed hostnames in urllib.parse on legacy Python builds.
